description: Hand-authored OpenAPI spec for Meta's Graph API ad-management surface (campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, audiences

tools.name: act-ad-account-id_create-ad
tools.description: Create an ad (adset_id, name, creative={creative_id}, status, etc.). Required: ad_account_id. Returns the new GraphSuccess.

tools.name: act-ad-account-id_create-ad-creative
tools.description: Create an ad creative (name, object_story_spec or asset_feed_spec, etc.). Required: ad_account_id. Returns the new GraphSuccess.

tools.name: act-ad-account-id_create-ad-set
tools.description: Create an ad set (campaign_id, name, targeting, daily_budget or lifetime_budget, billing_event, optimization_goal, bid_amount, status, etc.). Required: ad_account_id. Returns the new GraphSuccess.

tools.name: act-ad-account-id_create-campaign
tools.description: Create a campaign (name, objective, status, special_ad_categories, buying_type, etc.). Required: ad_account_id. Returns the new GraphSuccess.

tools.name: act-ad-account-id_create-custom-audience
tools.description: Create a custom audience (name, subtype, description, customer_file_source, etc.). Required: ad_account_id. Returns the new GraphSuccess.

tools.name: act-ad-account-id_get-ad-account
tools.description: Get ad account details. Required: ad_account_id. Optional: fields. Returns the GraphObject.

params.name: ad_account_id
params.description: Numeric ad account id, without the act_ prefix.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

tools.name: act-ad-account-id_get-ad-account-insights
tools.description: Get performance insights for an ad account (reporting). Required: ad_account_id. Optional: fields, date_preset, time_range (plus 2 more). Returns array of GraphObject.

tools.name: act-ad-account-id_list-ad-creatives
tools.description: List ad creatives in an ad account. Required: ad_account_id. Optional: fields, limit, after. Returns array of GraphObject.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

params.name: after
params.description: Cursor for the next page (from paging.cursors.after).
